simple.summary: סַנְסַנָּה (Çançannâh) means Sansannah , a place in Palestine First listed occurrence: Josh 15 31.

definitions.full: H5578. Sansannah סַנְסַנָּה proper name, of a location in southern Judah ; — Josh 15:31 , ᵐ5 Σεθεννακ , A Σανσαννα , ᵐ5 L Σεενακ ; probably = סוּסָה חֲצַר 19:5 , חֲצַרסֿוּסִים 1Chr 4:31 ; conjectures on location (near Gaza), see in Di on the passage Buhl Geogr. 163 and references ( Simsum , northeast of Gaza, compare by J. Schwarz Das heilig. Land (1852), 72 van d. Velde Mem, 346 , is too far north).
